summary: Backend-only testing of the new 'A.I. Vs Umani' community config feature (frequency + intro/outro jingles) and the community block injection into pick_next_segment. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_community_config.py: 15/16 passed. Regression of the 23 pre-existing community tests (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py): 23/23 passed. Community segment injection verified end-to-end (submit -> toggle ON -> freq=1 -> POST /api/segments/generate) with all required fields (kind=community, pre/post_jingle_url, script with 'A-I contro Umani' + artist/title, music_audio_url of the community track, dj_name in [Leo,Aria,Max], voice_key mapped, track_meta.is_community=true, llm_provider=community, songs_since_community reset to 0). Fallback path with no ON track also verified (returns non-community segment, no 500). No music generation (Suno/LLM) endpoints were called beyond POST /api/segments/generate which served existing library tracks.

minor.issue: Spec mismatch: frequency=51 is silently clamped to 50 and returns 200 {frequency:50} instead of the expected 400. Same for negative values (clamped to 0). Non-integer strings and missing frequency correctly return 400. Decide: either return 400 for out-of-range (per spec) or document clamping in the UI.

action_items: Decide/fix out-of-range frequency behaviour in PATCH /api/admin/community/config (400 vs clamp) and align the Dashboard input validation/message.
Re-upload real intro/outro jingles: testing left dummy silent MP3s at /app/backend/static/community/community_jingle_intro.mp3 and community_jingle_outro.mp3 and station.state URLs point to them.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~3476 lines — split into routers (community, palinsesto, admin) for maintainability.
Community/jingle endpoints have no auth at all (admin panel 'open in beta') — anyone can change frequency or overwrite station jingles; add a shared-secret/admin guard before launch.
PATCH /api/admin/community/config takes a raw dict instead of a Pydantic model; use a model with Field(ge=0, le=50) so FastAPI returns 422/400 consistently.
Community segment always picks the newest ON track (sort submitted_at desc) — the same track will replay every cycle; consider rotating by last_played_at.
seed_data_creation: Temporary community track TEST_Artista / TEST_Brano created and deleted during the injection test (DB now has 0 community tracks). community_frequency restored to 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_community_config.py (config GET/PATCH, jingle upload validation incl. >5MB and magic-bytes, /api/community_jingle whitelist + Accept-Ranges, community block injection). Run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_community_config.py tests/backend_test.py`. The injection test leaves frequency=0 afterwards. Frontend CommunityPanel config UI (data-testid=community-config-panel etc.) has NOT been tested yet.
rca_of_the_issue: PATCH handler uses `freq = max(0, min(50, int(freq)))`, which clamps out-of-range values instead of rejecting them; only a ValueError from int() produces the 400.
